batch_node.name: rampart-20x-playground Dimension Pack v0.5.0
batch_node.description: Two dimension axes as twenty-three dimension nodes (req-rampart-20x-playground-dimensions): `inventory` (the axis plus nine categories) and `dataclass` (the axis, its customer and infra sub-axes, and ten classes). No edges: the hierarchy is carried by the dotted name (req-dcom-naming). Each node carries `tap.meta: dimension` (core's default for the type) and NO `dcom` value: the pack is a dictionary, and dictionary entries are not entries in themselves. Node entity ids are minted once and never change; revising descriptions means a new batch id and a bumped batch name, with the node ids stable. v0.2.0 splits `inventory.os` into operating systems only and adds `inventory.containers` (req-rampart-20x-playground-inventory-dimension). v0.3.0 adds `inventory.packages` and `inventory.crypto` (req-rampart-20x-playground-inventory-software). v0.4.0 adds `dataclass.infra.admin` and rewrites every dataclass description in plain words with no backticks, because the Data classification cards render them literally. v0.5.0 adds `dataclass.customer.reader`, `dataclass.customer.writer` and `dataclass.customer.storage`.

node.name: inventory
node.description: The category an inventory item belongs to. Every item on the inventory page carries one `inventory` value: `applications`, `libraries`, `packages`, `os`, `containers`, `crypto`, `secrets`, `cloud` or `saas`. The nine values are the nodes named `inventory.<value>`. An entity carries one value or none.

node.name: inventory.applications
node.description: The `applications` category on the inventory axis: running applications inside the environment.

node.name: inventory.libraries
node.description: The `libraries` category on the inventory axis: software libraries.

node.name: inventory.packages
node.description: The `packages` category on the inventory axis: packages a package manager installed, one row per ecosystem, name and version.

node.name: inventory.os
node.description: The `os` category on the inventory axis: operating systems.

node.name: inventory.containers
node.description: The `containers` category on the inventory axis: container images, one row per class of identical image.

node.name: inventory.crypto
node.description: The `crypto` category on the inventory axis: cryptographic implementations found in the deployment's artifacts, with the reviewed decision about each.

node.name: inventory.secrets
node.description: The `secrets` category on the inventory axis: secret material, keys, certificates and secrets.

node.name: inventory.cloud
node.description: The `cloud` category on the inventory axis: internal AWS capabilities such as Route 53, Secrets Manager, IAM and VPCs that come from the cloud but are not an application, library or OS/container.

node.name: inventory.saas
node.description: The `saas` category on the inventory axis: third-party SaaS, the interconnected cloud systems, including AWS where all of this is hosted and GitHub where the code comes from.

node.name: dataclass
node.description: The class of data an item holds or handles. Two sub-axes, dataclass.customer and dataclass.infra, each take one value per entity. Entities are stamped as they are classified; the nodes exist so classification needs no vocabulary change.

node.name: dataclass.customer
node.description: Data that belongs to customers.

node.name: dataclass.infra
node.description: Data that belongs to running the infrastructure.

node.name: dataclass.customer.data
node.description: Customer data.

node.name: dataclass.customer.creds
node.description: Customer credentials.

node.name: dataclass.customer.logs
node.description: Customer logs.

node.name: dataclass.customer.reader
node.description: A component that reads customer data.

node.name: dataclass.customer.writer
node.description: A component that writes customer data.

node.name: dataclass.customer.storage
node.description: A component that stores customer data.

node.name: dataclass.infra.code
node.description: Infrastructure code.

node.name: dataclass.infra.secrets
node.description: Infrastructure secrets.

node.name: dataclass.infra.logs
node.description: Infrastructure logs.

node.name: dataclass.infra.admin
node.description: Infrastructure administration: administrator access to the infrastructure.

node.name: overview
node.description: Whether an entity is drawn on the Overview page. An entity on the Overview carries the value `shown`; the Overview's Searches select on it, so the list of what the page shows is data on the entities and not a list of types in each Search. The value is the node named `overview.shown`. An entity carries one value or none.

node.name: overview.shown
node.description: The `shown` value on the overview axis: the entity is drawn on the Overview page.
